summary: Fix directly addresses reported bug by always parenthesizing the Subs expression, matching how it was actually merged upstream. Minor stylistic quirk: it always adds parens even for atoms/simple expressions where unneeded, but this is not a functional or regression problem.

issues.description: Unconditional parenthesization rather than precedence-based check means atomic/simple expr args (e.g. a bare symbol) get redundant \left(...\right) wrapping; cosmetic only, not incorrect.
